title: The Bible was mistranslated – The Horror Game inspired by the Theory of the... (Tripo AI and Suno)
author: LearnSodas
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm happy to announce that the official trailer for [In Vino Veritas](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4348190/In_Vino_Veritas/?utm_source=reddit&utm_campaign=trailer_ai), a first-person psychological horror game for PC, is out!

I used **TripoAI** to help me with some 3D assets that I later modified and adapted to the style of the game, and used **Suno AI** to help compose the music. I'm a little worried about how people will perceive the AI usage, since I think it's not so noticeable but having that disclaimer on the Steam Page might keep people away

The story is inspired by Elohim theory, which claims that the Hebrew word "Elohim" (later translated as "God") is actually plural, and that the Bible speaks of multiple deities rather than a single god.

Your wife disappeared after a police search of an abandoned cathedral, and apparently the authorities have no jurisdiction there, so it's up to you to go looking for her before it's too late.

The game is played in first person and there's no combat.

\- Explore the cathedral and its foundations  
\- Solve environmental puzzles to progress  
\- Hide from or escape creatures that want to kill you  
\- Drink wine made from the blood of a renegade Elohim to find out what happened to your wife

I'm not a studio, I'm making the whole game by myself.

The demo is already available! It would really help me to hear what you think!
